project.title: Novel insight into the diversities of active tetracycline-resistant bacteria and genes in the activated sludge as revealed by in situ microcapsule-entrapped cultivation (IMEC)
project.description: This public dataset contains 16S rRNA gene sequencing data of tetracycline-resistant microorganisms in activated sludge analyzed via three methods (conventional isolation, direct sequencing, and in situ microcapsule-entrapped cultivation), along with PCR-amplified sequencing data of resistance genes tetC, tetG, tetM, and tetX from microbial genomes obtained by direct sequencing and in situ microcapsule-entrapped cultivation, all supporting research on tetracycline resistance in sludge microbiomes.

samples: Metagenome or environmental sample from activated sludge metagenome
explicit urban setting at sample level
activated sludge from a municipal wastewater treatment plant
